version_info.promotional_text: Review workplace risks from photos, prioritise findings with Fine-Kinney or 5×5, and create professional PDF and Excel reports.
version_info.description:
Review workplace risks from field photos and turn observations into structured, evidence-grounded findings with RiskDetected.

Designed for safety professionals, site managers, consultants and operations teams, RiskDetected organises photo observations into Risk Analysis, Expert Guidance, Approved Notebook drafts and Training Recommendations.

Key features:
• V4-assisted analysis of workplace photos
• Fine-Kinney and 5×5 risk assessment outputs
• Corrective actions, preventive activities and regulatory references
• PDF and Excel report creation, download and sharing
• Reporting for one finding or selected findings
• Report archive and persistent user feedback
• Company, preparer and logo details for reports
• Light and dark appearance support

RiskDetected provides AI-assisted decision support. Outputs may be incomplete or inaccurate and must be checked against the workplace. The app does not replace a qualified safety professional, a site inspection or legal review.

Some features and higher usage limits require a Plus or Pro subscription. Subscriptions are managed by Apple and purchases can be restored in the app.
